commands.quality_food.quality.failed.mis: %s does not have any quality to remove
quality_food.configuration.particles.too: Enable / Disable particles which indicate the stored quality level of certain blocks (e.g. furnace)
Enable / Disable effect tooltips for food items
quality_food.configuration.luck_multipli:
Luck will affect how often each quality will be tried for
(10 luck * 0.25 multiplier -> 2.5 rolls, meaning 2 rolls and 50% chance for another)
quality_food.configuration.crop_target_c:
The chance of quality crops dropping its own quality (also affects other qualities)
In case of Gold (0.6 / 0.03 = 20) the chances for all qualities would be: 20 * 0.10 (iron) = 2 (100%) | 20 * 0.03 (gold) = 0.6 (60%) | 20 * 0.005 = 0.1 (10%)
quality_food.configuration.seed_chance_m: Multiplier on top of the crop target chance (e.g. in case quality seeds should be more rare)
quality_food.configuration.farmland_conf:
Define multipliers to be applied per farmland on crops - Syntax: <index>;<crop>;<farmland>;<multiplier>
(Index determines check order - first matching one is applied) (Use # to specify tags)
quality_food.configuration.no_quality_re:
Define recipes (namespace:path) which should not result in quality being rolled (e.g. when the items can be converted back and forth)
This is not about keeping / retaining quality as a whole (e.g., in the case of storage-blocks - that is handled automatically + through the 'retain_quality_recipes' configuration)
quality_food.configuration.retain_qualit: Define recipes (namespace:path) which should result in the quality being applied to the result (only if all ingredients have the same quality)
quality_food.configuration.handle_seed_r: Attempt to handle recipes involving seed items automatically (to avoid having to add all of them to the retain_quality_recipes config)
quality_food.configuration.storage_recip: Define recipes (namespace:path) which should be excluded from the automatic storage block detection
quality_food.configuration.child_potenti: The base percentage of the (averaged) potential of the parents which gets passed on to the child
A random value between 0 and this amount is added to the base percentage
Multiplier on the potential gained through feeding a child (usually children can be fed more often)
quality_food.configuration.animal_potent: Defines how much the potential (0 - 1) of an animal increases the odds for quality (e.g. at 49 a potential of 1 results in a 50 times higher odds)
